page.notes: Doubtful readings: "quacunq;" (the sign after q is a superscript form of -que, read as ;), "αὐτοδιδάκτοις" and "θεοδίδακτοι" (Greek accents and letters uncertain at this scan resolution). Italic spans in paragraph VI are read from the scan and may not be exact. Printed "Possevinus" is set with long s and read as Possevinus. The Greek word Πολυπραγμοσυνῶν is split at the line end with the rest in the margin, which is transcribed in place. The final word "agun-" is a line-end fragment that continues on the next page.
